dct_title_s: Building Damage Assessment in Koshkak village, Zindajan District, Hirat Province, Afghanistan as of 16 October 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code EQ20231008AFG, GDACS Id: 1394952** This map illustrates destroyed and potentially damaged structures by the M6.3 Hirat earthquake of 15 October 2023 (03:36 UTC) as observed by using a Pléiades NEO very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 16 October 2023 at 06:44 UTC. Within the map extent, UNOSAT identified 491 destroyed structures, 1 potentially damaged structure and 179 temporary shelters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
